updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.9.9 
 - Move VKB BRA/BE display ribbon down on EFB Map both Portrait and Landscape orientations. 
 - VKB Tab Rail handling in Landscape orientaton on small devices now scales correctly. 
 - VKB FLT PLN Tab NAVLOG column scaling now has minimum width for readability and if required adds horizontal table psition bar at bottom of NALOG (iPad mini). 
 - DIR TO/DEL STP function now works similar to Alt/SPD popup edits, single click STP number and then select required mode to arm, click desired SIR TO STP or STP to delete. 
 - Fix VKB NAVLOG Metric units handling.
 - Fix last deleted F10 marker remains in VKB Map markers list and on EFB Moving Map. 
 - Add protection against slow DCs module disconnect and retry if reconnect fails first time due to socket not released.
 - Fix F-14B LANTIRN commands and move to proxy commands going forward.
 - New F-14B(U) wheel visibility enternal plugin contect commmands.
 - VKB new Stores pylon numbering F-14, F-16 and A-10C.
 - New in Game VAICOM PTT overlay display.
 - VKB F-4E AI CREW Keywords now have segments. 
 - VKB new Digital Elevation Model (DEM) implemented adds 30m resolution digital terrain data. 
 - VKB user waypoints now access DEM and add elevation data on creation. 
 - VKB EFB Moving Map now displayes Minimum Off Route Altitude (MORA) at top Left, indicates highest terrain within 40nm radius (ICAO buffers applied)
 - Add VKB MSA auto calculations to doghouses via the DEM 5nm each side of route +1000ft buffer.
 - Add more custom stores pages, AH-64D, F-4E.
 - Add global radial keyboard and calculator popup, allows send to any highlighted field in DCS.
 - Anchor Moving Map draw layer to map background all other draw canavas behaviour unchanged.
 - Add 'Jester Context' special command to open Jester Wheel to contect menu not main menu. 
 - VKB Moving Map draw canvas now caches draw strokes and points so load is reduced on map redraw with complex drawings and many layers open.
 - Fix delay in VAICOM UI opening due to host and LAN checks.
 - Reduce log spam on VAICOM UI Open command.
